implementation_notes: Source listings identify candidates only and do not establish a confirmed breach.
Ransomware sources must never be used to access, download, host, or distribute illicitly obtained data.
SEC disclosures must be linked to the primary filing and attributed to the filing entity.
Deduplicate CISA and NCSC canonical URLs against live configuration before enabling polling.
Every candidate requires credible corroboration before publication.
